rules.title: Mini Shai-Hulud npm supply chain campaign including TanStack compromised releases
rules.summary: Mini Shai-Hulud is an ongoing supply chain campaign affecting npm, PyPI, and Composer packages. This npm rule covers every npm row from the Socket CSV: 409 npm artifacts grouped into 175 full npm package names, including TanStack, OpenSearch, Squawk, Mistral AI npm SDKs, UiPath, Intercom, SAP CAP, and related packages. The campaign uses install-time JavaScript payloads such as router_init.js, router_runtime.js, and execution.js to harvest CI, cloud, npm, GitHub, Vault, Kubernetes, SSH, and AI-tool credentials, exfiltrate data, persist through developer tooling configuration, and self-propagate by republishing packages reachable through stolen credentials. The same CSV also listed non-npm artifacts that this schema cannot match directly: composer:intercom/intercom-php@5.0.2, pypi:guardrails-ai@0.10.1, pypi:lightning@2.6.2/2.6.3, pypi:mistralai@2.4.6.

remediation.summary: Remove every affected npm package version, rebuild dependency state from clean caches, and treat any developer host or CI runner that installed an affected artifact as compromised.
steps: Upgrade affected npm dependencies to versions confirmed clean by the upstream maintainer or pin to known-good versions published before the relevant compromise window.
Delete node_modules and package manager lockfiles, clear package manager caches, then reinstall from clean registries.
Audit lockfiles and package manifests for affected versions and for optionalDependencies entries pointing to github:tanstack/router#79ac49eedf774dd4b0cfa308722bc463cfe5885c.
Audit .claude/ and .vscode/ directories for router_runtime.js, setup.mjs, execution.js, unexpected hooks, and unexpected tasks.

Rotate credentials accessible to any environment that installed an affected version, including npm tokens, GitHub tokens, OIDC trusts, cloud credentials, Vault tokens, Kubernetes service account tokens, SSH keys, and AI-tool credentials.
Review CI, npm publishing, cloud, GitHub, Vault, and Kubernetes audit logs for activity after package installation or publication windows listed by Socket.
For the PyPI and Composer artifacts in the CSV, use ecosystem-specific scanners or package manager tooling until gouvernante supports those ecosystems.
Re-run gouvernante to verify no affected package versions or host indicators remain.
